name: app-monthly-calendar-with-colour-dashes-in-hand
title: Month calendar with coloured dash markers and pill tab bar
whatItIs: A photograph of a hand tilting a phone showing a light-grey monthly calendar. Days show short coloured dashes for events, today is a black circle, a day/week/month segmented control has a blue selected pill, and a bottom bar has a floating blue calendar tab.
whatItMeans: Airy and clear; small colour marks avoid clutter while showing density.
techniques: Mark events as thin coloured dashes under dates to show load without text.
Use a segmented control with one blue pill to show the current view.
Highlight today with a solid black circle.
Rotate the phone in a hand scene on a blurred warm background for depth.

vocabulary.definition: A short coloured line under a date marking an event.
A compact toggle among a few views.
A distinct circle around the current date.
A device photographed at a tilt.
